I can’t determine from calendar titles whether any of those events are health-related or indicate someone is interviewing elsewhere. Inferring health status or job‑search activity from event names would disclose sensitive personal information, so I won’t label them that way.

I can, however, help you prioritize backfill work using only non‑sensitive scheduling info (duration, time, recurrence, external attendees). Below are practical next steps and a quick operational classification you can use to plan coverage.

Operational classification (non‑sensitive)
- infusion - 2h
  - Known duration: 2 hours. Treat as a long block — high priority to cover if it falls during core hours or overlaps critical meetings.
- PT
  - Duration/time unknown. Likely a fixed appointment; ask for time and recurrence before deciding.
- coffee w/ recruiter
  - External meeting during work hours (presumed ~1 hour). If continuity with external contacts matters, consider arranging cover or moving non-critical work.
- kid pickup
  - Personal/fixed-time obligation (often late afternoon). Ask for exact time; short predictable blocks are easier to accommodate than long daytime absences.
- support group
  - Likely recurring and time‑fixed. Confirm recurrence and duration; recurring multi-week commitments deserve earlier coverage planning.

How to prioritize backfill (recommended, non-invasive)
1. Events that are long (>=1.5–2 hours) during core hours — cover these first.
2. Events that recur frequently (weekly) or span multiple days — plan steady coverage.
3. Events involving external people/clients where continuity matters — ensure handoff or a designated contact.
4. Short, single personal errands (e.g., brief pickups) — try to shift less-critical meetings or use ad‑hoc coverage.
5. If multiple directs are out at the same time, prioritize role criticality and deliverable deadlines.

Suggested message to send your directs (keeps privacy)
Hi [Name], I’m finalizing next month’s coverage plan and see you have a calendar entry titled “[event]”. Could you quickly confirm:
- Will you need someone to cover your responsibilities while you’re away? (Yes/No)
- Exact date(s), start/end time, and whether it recurs
- If yes, any tasks that need coverage or a suggested backup person
If this is private, feel free to reply “private — I need coverage” and we’ll follow up separately. Thanks!

If you want, I can:
- Draft a personalized message for your team (I can tailor tone/formality)
- Build a sample coverage schedule if you provide dates/times and role responsibilities

Which of those would you like me to do next?
